book.name: GALESIA
book.title: Pol nainge tup nal me lenge Galesia

content: Wah tikin Krais ŋende poi tahar talah tikin Got

O tukwini ma plihe mininge meŋelꞌe wusyep menge mil tuꞌe leꞌe. Ŋaiye yai ka ole no, ka osme ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe embere embere kin lalme luku elme talah kin ŋaiye teter kin lahmalaih pe, talah uku kin ka yai me ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe luku ŋupe ŋaiye kin ka tuhur bworenge. Kom talah uku teter ka ŋahilyeh tuꞌe miyeꞌ wah pakaiye yai kin.
Ŋupe ŋaiye teter kin lahmalaih pe, lenge miyeꞌ syeꞌ bepteme kin, topoꞌe tinge bepteme ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme ŋaiye yai kin yi tutume ŋupe ŋaiye yai tehei kitikin si nalaŋatme.
Ŋahwikin ilyeh uku pe, poi topoꞌe, poi marp miyeꞌ tuweinge wah titinge lenge yipihinge pupwa ŋaiye bepteme kekep eꞌe.
Kom ŋupe ŋaiye ŋup kitikin uku si nat pe, Got si nember Talah kin nat. Kin nat taꞌe talah ŋaiye tuwei ende waraꞌe pe, kin narp tuwihme wusyep erŋeme lenge Juta.
Got nember kin nat ŋaiye ka ungwisme poi lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye poi marp tuwihme wusyep erŋeme no, poi ya murp talah tikin Got.
Taꞌe na, yip topoꞌe poi si marp taꞌe talah tikin Got pe, Got nember Yohe Yirise tikin Talah nate ŋoto ŋoihmbwaip poi lalme pe, tukwini ya lalme gwilme kin tuꞌe leꞌe, “Aba, Yai”.
Taꞌe luku pe, yip yukur yarp taꞌe miyeꞌ wah pakaiye. Yip si yarp taꞌe talah wim kitikin. Pe Got se ka yul yip ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore.
Pol ŋoihginirme lenge Galesia
Yerkeime nenge nat yukur yip sisyeme Got pe, yip yarp miyeꞌ wah tikin got homboꞌe.

Kom tukwini ma mininge tuꞌe leꞌe: Yip si sisyeme Got pe, Got si sisyeme yip. Detaꞌe lai ti yip plihe bunjenge yala junde yipihinge pupwa ŋaiye bongol pakai? Topoꞌe yip plihe yala yil tuꞌe miyeꞌ wah tinge.
Nye nyermbe yip ŋoiheryembe nange pa junde wusyep erŋeme tikin ŋup embere ŋaiye yende lotu, topoꞌe wundehei ŋaiye bor ŋambaran, topoꞌe ŋup embere tikin lotu ŋaiye wahtaip ŋambaran.
O ŋam sikirp ŋoihmane me yip. Wah nihe ŋaiye ŋam mende me yip, se ka el luh paka pakaiye.
Lenge toꞌ tatai ŋam, ŋam misilih yip ŋaiye pa tuꞌe ŋam. Ŋam si masme yaŋah ŋaiye jande wusyep erŋeme pe, ŋam ŋahilyeh taꞌe yip. Topoꞌe yukur yip yende pupwa yatme ŋam.
Yip si sisyeme ŋaiye somohon ŋendeheiyeh kin ŋaiye ŋam mat me yip pe, ŋam mende wahriꞌ epwa. Luku tehei kin ŋaiye ki kumbur kohmap ŋaiye ŋam manange malaŋatme wusyep bwore mise tikin Krais malme yip.

Yip sisyeme ŋaiye ŋam mende wahriꞌ epwa pe, yip yekepe nihe. Kom yip yukur yende sisyoꞌ me ŋam, lakai yip jarnge ŋam. Ŋam hriphrip ŋaiye yip yambaꞌe ŋam yenge yat yoto moi yip taꞌe ŋaiye yip yambaꞌe walip hlaꞌ ende, lakai Krais Jisas.
Somohon yip hriphrip topoꞌe tapam ilyeh me ŋam pe, ŋaiye yip tatame pe, pa yongoꞌ ŋembep yip pule, ŋaiye pa yungwisme ŋembep pupwa ŋam. Detaꞌe lai ti yukur yip hriphrip tukwini?
Taꞌe ŋam wachaih yip ŋaiye ŋam mana yip wusyep mise?

Lenge mitiŋ uku tinge homboꞌe yenge wahriꞌ wicherꞌ hihembepme yip iki, kom ŋoihmbwaip meleꞌe tinge pe, yukur sai topoꞌme yip ŋaiye ka yungwis yip. Tinge homboꞌe de ka bunjenge ŋoihmbwaip yip yil wohme ŋam no, ŋoihmbwaip yip ka ende nihararme tinge ŋaiye pa yungwis lenge.
Ki bwore ŋaiye nye nyermbe pa yende ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore bwore junde ŋoihmbwaip ŋaiye ki bwore yil lenge mitiŋ. Ŋupe ŋaiye yukur ŋam marp motop yip pe, pa yende ŋahwikin ilyeh tuꞌe luku yenge yil.
Lenge talah ŋam ŋaiye ŋam mende nihararme! Ŋam mambaꞌe syohme yip ŋahilyeh taꞌe ŋaiye tuwei de ta waraꞌe talah. Detale, ŋam masande ŋaiye pa yurp ŋahilyeh tuꞌe Krais.
Ŋam masande ŋaiye tukwini ma otop yip murp no, ma mini yip wusyep bwore bwore ŋaiye ka ungwisme yip. Taꞌe luku pe, ma se mungwisme yip tuꞌe la?
Wusyep tapimbilme Hagar hindi Sara
Ŋam de ma misilih yip lahmende ŋaiye yarp tuwihme wusyep erŋeme tuꞌe leꞌe, yip sisyeme ŋaimune ŋaiye wusyep erŋeme ŋanange, lakai pakai?
Tup Got ŋanange na, talah kin Abraham hoi. Ŋoinde pe, tuwei wah pakaiye waraꞌe, kut ŋoinde pe, tuwei tehei kitikin waraꞌe.
Talah ŋaiye tuwei wah pakaiye waraꞌe pe, ki ŋahilyeh taꞌe ŋaiye tuweinge lalme yaraꞌe, kut talah ŋaiye tuwei tehei kitikin waraꞌe pe, ki nat gande wusyep upwaiꞌe tikin Got.

Wusyep eꞌe pe, wusyep tapimbilme. Tuweinge hoi uku pe, tinge hindi yalaŋatme kontrak hoi ŋaiye Got nupwaiꞌe. Hagar ti walaŋatme hwate Sainai pe, talah ti kin miyeꞌ wah pakaiye ŋaiye narp tuwihme wusyep erŋeme.
Wusyep tapimbilme Hagar pe, ti gwan walaŋatme hwate Sainai nato kekep Arebia pe, ki nalaŋatme Jerusalem ŋaiye tukwini sai. Pe Jerusalem uku ti warp tuwei wah pakaiye wenge lenge talah ti.
Kom Jerusalem ŋoinde ŋaiye sai nanah moihlaꞌ pe, ti warp bwore hlaininge pe, ti taꞌe mam poi.
Wusyep tikin Got ŋanange na,

content.text: Nin tuwei ŋaiye gan pakaiye yukur ŋaraꞌe talah pe, na hriphrip.
Na tambah topoꞌe na hriphrip osoko wenersep
ŋaiye nin yukur ŋaraꞌe talah, pakai.
Detale, nin na hriphrip ŋaiye nin talah wula wula
engelyembe tuwei ŋaiye si windiꞌe miyeꞌ.

content: Tukwini yip toꞌ tatai ŋam, yip ŋahilyeh taꞌe Aisak ŋaiye gande wusyep upwaiꞌe tikin Got.
Ŋup uku pe, talah ŋaiye nat gande ŋasande tititinge yai hindi mam pe, kin ŋende yumbune talah ŋaiye mam waraꞌe gwande bongol tikin Yohe Yirise. Pe ki ŋahilyeh taꞌe tukwini.
Kom wusyep Got ŋanange taꞌe la? Ki ŋanange na,

content.text: Ember tuwei wah pakaiye hindi talah ti ka yil.
Detale, talah titi tuwei wah pakaiye yukur ka se hindi hoime
tunuh me ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe yai tinge hindi, na pakai.

content: Taꞌe luku pe, toꞌ tatai ŋam, poi yukur talah titi tuwei wah pakaiye, pakai. Poi talah titi tuwei hlaininge.
